ctaHeading: Need a Handyman in Reservoir? Let's Get It Done.
aboutText: JT Handyman Solutionz has been delivering quality handyman services across Reservoir and Melbourne's northern suburbs for years. Our skilled team, led by Jabez and Ryan, handles everything from painting and plumbing to renovations and carpentry with reliability at the core. We are a local Melbourne business trusted by homeowners and property managers alike, focused on getting your job done right the first time.
servicesText: From painting and plumbing to renovations and outdoor structures, JT Handyman Solutionz covers all your handyman needs. We specialise in residential and rental property services across Reservoir and greater Melbourne.

services.title: Painting & Finishes
services.desc: Interior and exterior painting with clean, professional finishes. We deliver quality results that freshen up any property.

services.title: Plumbing Services
services.desc: Reliable plumbing repairs and maintenance for homes and rental properties. Fast diagnostics and dependable solutions every time.

services.title: Electrical Services
services.desc: Safe and compliant electrical work for residential and commercial properties. Licensed solutions across Reservoir and Melbourne.

services.title: Renovations & Maintenance
services.desc: Full renovation and ongoing maintenance services tailored to your property. From minor repairs to complete property makeovers.

services.title: Outdoor Structures & Carpentry
services.desc: Decks, pergolas, fencing and timber repairs built to last. Custom carpentry solutions for outdoor living spaces.

services.title: Windows, Glazing & Property Services
services.desc: Window repairs, glazing solutions and complete property services for landlords and real estate managers across Melbourne.
